tools.name: domain_whois
tools.description: WHOIS/RDAP record of a domain from whois.ip-db.com: registrar, creation date (domain age), expiry date, status codes, nameservers, the hosting IPs with their ip-db.com reputation, subdomain count and a short security assessment (SPF, DMARC, TLS, transfer lock). Works for .com.tr and the other .tr do

tools.name: check_ip
tools.description: Reputation of one IP address from IP-DB: 0-100 abuse confidence score and label, network type (residential, datacenter/hosting, vpn, tor), the threat-intelligence blocklists and DNSBLs that list it, community abuse reports, country, ASN and owner, the network's abuse contact, and a fraud-screening r

tools.name: check_blacklists
tools.description: Check one IP address against every threat-intelligence blocklist IP-DB carries plus live DNSBL/RBL spam blacklists (SpamCop, Barracuda, PSBL, UCEPROTECT, Mailspike and more). Returns which lists carry it and which do not.
